arabic: وَاللهِ إِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً.
transliteration: Wallaahi innee la'astaghfirullaaha wa atoobu ilayhi fil-yawmi akthara min sab'eena marrah.
translation: By Allah, I seek the forgiveness of Allah, and repent to Him more than seventy times in a day.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ.
transliteration: Yaa ayyuhan-naasu tooboo ilallaahi fa-innee atoobu fil-yawmi ilayhi mi'ata marrah.
translation: O people, repent to Allah, for I repent to Him one hundred times a day.

arabic: مَنْ قَالَ: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ، غَفَرَ اللهُ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ.
transliteration: Astaghfirullaahal-'atheemal-lathee laa ilaaha illaa huwal-hayyal-qayyoomu wa atoobu ilayh.
translation: Whoever says: 'I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, Whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, The Living, The Eternal, and I repent to Him,' Allah will forgive him even if he had fled from the battlefield.
